title: Adobe Stock Contributor Agreement — Additional Terms to Adobe General Terms of Use
version_or_date: Effective as of February 16, 2024. Replaces all prior versions.

parties.licensor: The contributor (or the copyright owner on whose behalf the contributor submits) grants the licence to Adobe.
parties.licensee: Adobe Inc. for contributors resident in the US; Adobe Canada Services Corporation for contributors resident elsewhere (including India). Adobe sublicenses to users (buyers) under its own User Agreements.

permitted_use.value: Contributor licenses Adobe to use, reproduce, display, perform, distribute, index, translate and modify the Work to run the site, license it to users, develop new features and services, archive and protect it, and (for discretionary pay) to market Adobe; users/partners may share on social media and via an API partner programme.

ai_training_rights.value: Not addressed expressly: no mention of AI, machine learning, training, fine-tuning, evaluation, dataset redistribution or model outputs; the only possible hook is Adobe's own perpetual, royalty-free licence for 'developing new features and services', with no AI-specific payment; what users may do with Works for AI is left to Adobe's User Agreements, not in this document.

field_of_use.value: Any media or embodiment and any subject matter, except pornographic or illegal uses (contributor waives objection); Adobe may treat Work as editorial-use-only, which can be accepted without releases.

territory.value: Worldwide, both for Adobe's licence and for sublicences to users.

term_duration.value: Perpetual licences; contributor may end the Additional Terms on 90 days' written notice, Adobe without notice; licences already granted survive.

exclusivity.value: Non-exclusive in both directions: contributor to Adobe, and Adobe's sublicences to users; the document offers no exclusive licence route.

sublicensing.value: Adobe may sublicense use, reproduction, display, distribution and modification to users under its own User Agreements, and let users and authorised third parties share Works; API partners facilitate sales.

derivatives_and_model_outputs.value: User licences may include modifying and creating derivative works and selling merchandise incorporating the Work; modified Work limited to the uses allowed for the original; silent on model outputs.

attribution.value: No attribution duty: Adobe and users may but need not credit the creator, users are not obliged to credit in commercial use, metadata may be changed; Adobe may use the contributor's name and marks in marketing.

deletion_on_termination.value: No deletion duty on Adobe: after termination it may keep the Work for internal archival and reference use; licences already granted to users and Adobe survive.

warranties_by_provider.value: Contributor warrants ownership of or rights to the Work (including privacy, publicity and moral rights), non-infringement, no misleading/illegal/defamatory content, authority when submitting for other owners, and truthfulness for editorial Work; warranties survive termination.

consent_and_release_warranty.value: Contributor warrants it holds valid model/property releases similar to Adobe's standard forms for every identifiable person, logo or protected property, and must hand copies to Adobe on request; editorial-only Work may be accepted without releases; nothing requires releases to reach buyers.

indemnity.value: Contributor indemnifies Adobe, its affiliates, partners, licensees and licensors including users against claims from submitted Works, site use or breach; no cap stated; Adobe controls the defence and may offset against royalties; survives termination.

liability_cap.value: No cap stated here; Adobe excludes liability to contributors for users' breach of User Agreements or third-party misuse, for metadata changes and for representatives' advice, and gives no revenue warranty; any general cap is in the General Terms.

payment_and_revenue_share.value: Adobe pays per licence sale, net of cancellations/returns/refunds, at rates on a separate help page it can change unilaterally; nothing for free content, promotions, trials or watermarked versions, discretionary for marketing use, none if terminated for cause; tax withheld; indemnity amounts offset; post-termination licence fees still paid.

takedown_and_erasure.value: Contributor may remove Work any time (bulk removals over 100 items/10% in 90 days need 90 days' notice); affiliates' copies removed within 60 days on reasonable efforts, with new licences possible until then; licences already sold survive, so buyers keep their copies, and comp holders may still convert.

change_of_terms.value: Terms replace all prior versions and apply to Works uploaded under earlier versions; Adobe may change Pricing and Payment Details unilaterally, accepted by continuing to upload or not removing Works; Guidelines incorporated by reference.

prohibited_uses.value: User Agreements bar pornographic or illegal use of Works; contributors may not download content to inflate download counts or trigger payments.

unknowns.note: The Additional Terms contain no governing-law or forum clause; they defer to the Adobe General Terms of Use (www.adobe.com/go/terms), which were not read for this file.
No contributor audit right over Adobe's sales records or royalty calculations, and no Adobe audit right over users, is stated.

The document never names AI or model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, dataset redistribution or model-output rights, nor any payment tied to AI use; whether Adobe relies on 'developing new features and services' for training is not stated here.
Royalty percentages sit on the separate Pricing and Payment Details help page (helpx.adobe.com/stock/contributor/help/royalty-details.html), not in this document.
The User Agreement under which Adobe sublicenses to buyers (AI use, deletion duties, exclusivity, indemnity to buyers) is referenced but not part of this document.
Releases must be supplied to Adobe on request; the document says nothing about releases being shown or delivered to buyers.
No mechanism for a depicted person's erasure request reaching copies already licensed; the only rule stated is that licences granted before removal survive.
No monetary cap on either party's liability or on the contributor's indemnity appears in the Additional Terms.
